translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Iesusa mac nda ŋgepatna
Na raita ŋgat kabena ra lacaua, Makdala auŋna Maria, ma auŋ raruna morina ŋaŋarmuŋ ŋgoinna ma mukca taŋrina. Na ma watrinanna wautta tɨŋmo mboraca eacrenanna, anna tɨŋmo mba mboracri.

Ainda moca ma ootta taŋga Saimon Pitaapa an Iesusna iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrta ramootta, Iesusa manmo matŋirenanmo, ma maniŋmo aindoprina, “Mina Kacootmo mukca tɨkca aŋgɨa mataŋri, na mina manmo tenna tɨkrinanna, aia mba lamŋireke.”
Ri, Pitaapa an Iesusna iŋa raŋgairena ramootta, maniŋa ŋgepca auŋ tɨkcarica muk ndambuŋ mataŋri.
Na maniŋa muruŋniŋa ootrinan, na an Iesusna iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrta an ramootta Iesusa matŋirenanna, ma Pitamo ootta kunda ma mukmo outta taŋga malaruat.
Na ma ramtukca ŋaia watta mbukrinanna, na ma watrinanna, mina Iesusna waɨrmo tamairina raraŋgir laiŋ kamndera ndori eacrina. Na ma mba mbukatke.
Ri, Saimon Pita ma mana iŋ nakɨpca laruca ma muk mambukat. Na ma watrinanna, raraŋgir tiŋgikca ndoria eacrenan,

na ma kabena raraŋit motocmo watrina, anna mina Iesusna paŋanna tamaiatnanna, anna mba eacatke. Na an raraŋitta ma an ndeacrena raraŋgirap mba eacri. Wanaiŋ. Manmo ramootta aŋgɨca rukumbca aŋgɨca kabena taupca tɨkca eacrina kirar toc.
Ainda moca an Iesusna iŋa raŋgairena ramootta outta larurinanna, ma toco mbukrina. Na ma an reikca watca ma marɨpacat.
Na an mɨnna mina Raraŋ Aetaniacna Timbigta Kap ndeacrena kambca mba gɨwaca lamŋireke, Iesusa muk ŋgetacndiŋ mac ŋgepnandet.
Karica an mana iŋa raŋgairena ramootniŋa auŋ aniac mac nda mataŋgat.
Makdala auŋna Maria ma Iesusmo watrina
Ri, Maria ma an mukmo raekmbaia aea eacri. Na ma ae mbuŋa ramtukca ma mukna inikca watta mbukatke.

Ma tik ŋgapaoc gogok aoca eacrena mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ŋeroŋ mbuniŋ mawatri. Na an mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ŋeroŋniŋa an Iesusna waɨra eacrina taupca mbiraca eacrena. Ianna mana paŋanna eacrina taup, na ianna mana orniŋa eacrina taupca mbiraca eacrina.
Karica maniŋa Mariamo gainda digirina, “Meacmbitac, kaina moca u aerena.” Ri, ma maniŋmo gainda rutiatna, “Mina aukna Kacootna waɨrmo aŋgɨca tenna tɨkrinanna, aku mba lamŋireke.”
Na ma aindopacarica, ma kumbakeca watrinanna, ma Iesusmo mawatri. Na ma mba lamŋiri, anna Iesus.

Ainda moca Iesusa manmo gainda digirina, “Meacmbitac kaina moca u aerena? Na u mandaina ŋgorerena?” Na Maria anmo warɨŋna aiŋa morena ramoot ndopca, ma manmo gaindopatna, “Ramoot aniac, u manmo aŋgɨ taŋ te, u aukmo tɨkrina taup ndop te, aku taŋca manmo aŋgɨna.”
Ri, Iesusa gaindopatna, “Maria.” Na Maria kumbakeca manmo Iburuna kam mbuŋa gaindopatna, “Rabonai.” Na an kam, “Rabonai,” mana mɨnɨŋa gaind, “Riripti.”

Karica Iesusa manmo gaindoprina, “U aukmo kai utiŋ teac, aku ndona Aet ndambuŋmo mba gacreke. Na u taŋga aukna laiplacarmo gaindop, aku tamuŋ naganandet. Na aku ndona Aetapa nena Aet ndambuŋa taŋnandet. Na aku ndona Raraŋ Aetaniacapa nena Raraŋ Aetaniac ndambuŋa taŋnandet.”
Ainda moca Makdala auŋna Maria ma ŋgepca taŋga, mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrmo gaindopatna, “Aku Kacootmo watrina.” Ri, Iesusa manmo neaŋrina kambmo, ma minmo mboprina.
Mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra Iesusmo watrina

Na mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra Iudanaŋgepta moca nanambirina, aintik mina eacrena an kacna tɨŋmo kaptikica leacrina. Na an raipaikna ŋgatna ra lacaua maica ra irikca wigwacari, Iesusa kɨpca mina rɨk mawɨtɨkat. Na ma minmo gaindopatna, “Nena iroar inkara wetwet laŋ ndeacraŋ.”
Karica ma aindopacarica, ma minmo ndona parapa kanmbacarpaikna ndibmo minmo mawandacat. Na mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra Kacootmo watca mina iroar inkara toŋtoŋgar koinda morina.
Ri, Iesusa minmo gaind mac mbopatna, “Nena iroar inkara wetwet laŋ ndeacraŋ, na Aetta aukmo mbagɨrica aku kɨprinan, na an kirara aku nenmo mbagɨrica ne taŋnandet.”
Na ma aindopri, ma ndona watmo minmo wica taŋga, ma minmo gaindopatna, “Ne Ŋeroŋ Ratmo aŋgɨ.

Na ne meikramtaɨrta tɨpemb ŋgorikta makukarmo, mo kecari te, mina tɨpemb ŋgorikta makukara mainandet. Na ne mina tɨpemb ŋgorikta makukarmo moi kecari ŋgocor te, mina an tɨpemb ŋgorikta makukarap eacraŋnandet.”
Tomasa Iesusmo watrina
Na an mɨnna Iesusa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨr tambuŋ ndarurinanna, mina ramtaɨrpaikna ianna ma minap mba eacri. Anna Tomas, na mana i tekera Didimus.

Ainda moca iŋmbai mbuŋa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra Tomasmo gaindopatna, “Aia Kacootmo watrina.” Na ma minmo gaindoprina, “Aku mana lacna ndibca mina mana para tɨkrinanna wat ŋgocor, na aku ndona patŋitmo an ndibembta ge tɨk ŋgocor, na aku mana kanmbaca ndona par mbuŋa utiŋ ŋgocor tik, aku mba rɨpacitndai. Wanaiŋ ŋgoin.”

Na rai parmbaiapa mbut mbuniŋna iŋmbai mbuŋa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra an kac inik ndeacrinan, na Tomas toco, ma minap eacrina. Na mina an kacna tɨŋmo kaptikica leacrinan, na Iesusa kɨpca mina rɨkca wɨtɨkrina. Na ma minmo gaindoprina, “Nena iroar inkara wetwet laŋ ndeacraŋ.”
Karica ma Tomasmo aindopatna, “U kɨpca ndona patŋitmo ganna tɨk, na u aukna para wat. Na u ndona parmo aukna kanmbacarpaikmo, u utiŋ. Na u iro mbuniŋa kai aŋgɨ teac, u rɨpac niŋgik.”
Na Tomasa mana kambmo gainda rutirinan, “U aukna Kacoot, na u aukna Raraŋ Aetaniac.”
Karica Iesusa manmo gaindopatna, “U aukmo watca u rɨpacri ki? Na meikramtaɨra aukmo wat ŋgocor, na rɨpacrinanna, an meikramtaɨra mina toŋtoŋgar tiŋgik.”
Ganna Ionna timbigta kapna mɨnɨŋ ŋgoin
Ainda moca Iesusa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrta lamnik ŋgoutmo ainta ŋgagatracar wɨtta morinanna, aku anmo gan timbigta kapca mba tirri.

Na an kambca aku tirrinanna, anna aku tirca ne Iesusmo rɨpacnandet, ma an ramootta Raraŋ Aetaniaca babuca mbagɨrica kɨpca aimo mac nda aŋgɨna ramoot. Na ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc. Aintik ne rɨpac te, ne eteacna watmo mana i mbuŋa aŋgɨnandet.

footnotes.text: Warɨŋna aiŋa morena ramoot An mukca ma warɨŋna inikca eacrena.
